answer.says: Very well, sir. I will not trouble you. Please, do not let the clerk's file disturb your rest. I shall take my breakfast here; the parathas look ready, and the air, though hazy, is mild enough to sit out in.
answer.thought: Shri Hegde's refusal to move is a practical assertion of his own particularity against the universal claim of the state's file. He treats the bungalow as his own domain, a concrete fact that resists the abstract order of the Directorate. I shall accept this boundary for now; it is better to observe the reality of his stubbornness than to argue with it before I have eaten. The aloo parathas are a particular pleasure that will sustain the spirit for the walk.
